Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the department of labor and industries to charge child labor law administration fees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to establishing fees to administer child laborlaws; and adding a new section to chapter 49.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 49.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall charge a fee of ten dollars per businesslocation for the administration and enforcement of the minor workpermit requirements of RCW 49.12.121 or 49.12.123 or a rule or orderadopted under RCW 49.12.121 or 49.12.123. The fee shall be used solelyto review minor work permit applications to verify that minors employedat business locations are performing work duties limited to thoseallowed under the permit and to verify that minors are no longeremployed at business locations that have not renewed their annual minorwork permits. Fees collected from minor work permits shall bedeposited in the state general fund and may be appropriated by thelegislature for the purposes of this section.
